closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin E, protein, and magnesium, but the biggest weaknesses are low calcium, low fibre, and low omega 3. It is good for immune support, blood and oxygen support, and bone health because zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with.
